# teams agent blueprint delete

Delete an Agent 365 agent blueprint and its resources

## Usage

```
teams agent blueprint delete [blueprintId] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `blueprintId` | [OPTIONAL] Agent blueprint ID to delete. Overrides agent.generated.config.json when given; required if no local config exists. | No |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
| `--dry-run` | [OPTIONAL] Show resources that would be deleted without making any changes |
